stdout:
Delete live chat bans. Use this tool to unban users from a live chat by ban IDs.

Usage:
  yutu liveChatBan delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a live chat ban by ID
yutu liveChatBan delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple live chat bans
yutu liveChatBan delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for delete
  -i, --ids strings   IDs of the live chat bans to delete
      --yes           Confirm the operation
